description: This file defines the 'Tag' struct used in the Orleans serialization wire protocol, representing a serialization tag byte with various properties and masks for serialization metadata.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: A struct representing a serialization tag byte used in Orleans wire protocol, encapsulating various properties and masks for serialization control.

methods.description: Converts a byte to a Tag struct.
